name: Katsuura (Tokushima, Japan)
description: A navy field charged at the centre with the Katsuura town emblem in white: a disc crossed by winged horizontal bars, like a stylised character.
history: Municipal flag of Katsuura, a town in Tokushima Prefecture; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. The municipal emblem was adopted in October 1965.

features.role: Katsuura town emblem — a disc crossed by winged horizontal bars, like a stylised character
